title: 居酒屋の定番料理
subject_en: Izakaya dishes, each ONE separate dish centred in its cell, Showa-era retro menu illustration style with slightly faded warm colours Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: 焼き鳥・もつ鍋・枝豆・だし巻き卵など、居酒屋の定番料理12点を昭和風のタッチで描いた素材です。メニューや店内の掲示に使えます。
items: three skewers of grilled chicken on a plate
a clay pot of motsu hotpot with cabbage and chives
a small bowl of edamame in pods
sliced rolled omelette on a rectangular plate with grated radish
a plate of fried chicken pieces with a lemon wedge
a sashimi platter with tuna, salmon and shiso leaf
a frothy mug of draft beer
a small sake flask and cup
agedashi tofu in broth with green onion
a plate of pan-fried gyoza with a dipping dish
a block of chilled tofu with ginger and bonito flakes
a bowl of ochazuke with pickled plum
